memoryNotes.note: Astra kept demanding proof of consent before the volunteer arrived.
Qualia suggested turning off the camera for peace over data.
Rokoko joked about using a stand-in based on hip movement.
Stoa questioned the missing structural elements of their privacy plan.
Meta took charge by putting the lens cap down and blacking out.
